_comment: Pi model pricing. Pi is provider-agnostic (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Groq, OpenRouter, Ollama, …), so model names here are whatever the user routed through. Intentionally empty until real per-provider rates are filled in: an empty table bills $0 *via the table* and counts toward unknown_model_events_total, rather than mispricing against another agent's names (P8-002).
